basic.name: Mónica Perdomo Santana
basic.summary: I'm a QA Tester, working on a project for a major insurance company. I perform functional and linguistic testing of web applications using Jira and Xray in an Agile/Scrum environment. Passionate about software quality, I continue learning through my personal project, Solara Codeworks.

experiences.title: QA Tester
experiences.details: Perform functional and linguistic testing of Generali’s internal web app for insurance policy management. Collaborate with developers, QAs, and POs in an Agile/Scrum environment. Use Jira and Xray to create, execute, and track test cases, ensuring high-quality software delivery.

experiences.title: QA Tester (Collaborative Project)
experiences.details: Designed and executed manual test cases. Logged and tracked bugs using Jira. Performed REST API testing with Postman. Gained experience with basic JavaScript and real-world QA practices within the software development life cycle. Worked in an Agile/Scrum environment.

experiences.title: Translator & Interpreter (FR–ES / EN–ES)
experiences.details: Interpreted in real time in police stations, courts, and humanitarian contexts. Translated official documents and managed sensitive multilingual communication. Developed precision, confidentiality, and adaptability in high-pressure settings.
